01 / THE SCIENTIFIC PROBLEM

Why MODIS and VIIRS differ

MODIS
~1 km nominal

~375 m nominal
NOAA-20 / NOAA-21COMMON SUPPORT

Native footprint, sensitivity, overpass time, cloud and confidence semantics differ. Counts cannot be naively pooled into a sensor-neutral trend.

Native fire masks + valid opportunity + geolocation → matched overpasses → adjustment → independent validation is a FUTURE scientific pipeline, not an existing calibrated result.

01 / ACTUAL OBSERVATIONS

One bounded, reproducible Brazil pilot

Mato Grosso: W −57, S −14, E −55, N −12.

August 2024: 6,876 authentic detections, 152 occupied H3 resolution-6 cells, four exact source strata.

Broader Brazil archive: 26,419,602 indexed observations. Source history remains separate.

Original UTC, FRP, source/platform and native confidence are preserved. Point previews are explicitly bounded.

02 / COMMON SUPPORT

More than merging points

Group actual detections by exact source × common cell × UTC day.

  • H3 resolutions 4–8, actual cell areas.
  • Declared equal-area grids: 1 / 2 / 5 km.
  • MODIS-only, VIIRS-only and unified source-aware occupancy.
  • Selectable original observations, paired evidence, provenance and complete cell-day exports.

No-data is not zero fires. Same-day co-detection is not a shared event or simultaneous acquisition.

05 / EXPERIMENTAL AI

A real research extension, with mixed results

Target: mean reported FRP conditional on a source-positive H3 cell-day. Not forecasting, sensor adjustment, downscaling or reconstruction.

988 actual labeled groups · 282 training · 60 depth-3 gradient-boosting trees. Separate dates and held H3 parent blocks.

Holdout / nBaseline MAEML MAEBaseline RMSEML RMSE
temporal / 30624.00327.21654.77559.370
spatial / 25224.85523.88980.37480.520
joint / 14816.56116.47239.19842.450

MW errors. Temporal performance is worse than baseline. Joint MAE is marginally lower, RMSE worse. No calibrated uncertainty interval or independent-year validation.

06 / PROOF & NEXT EVIDENCE

A working demonstration, with explicit limits

Proved

  • Real Brazil indexing, common source-aware support.
  • Actual detection overlap and historical calendar.
  • Trained exploratory FRP model, held-out evaluation.
  • Four visible sections; English/Arabic, desktop/mobile, real CSV/JSON and printable reports.

Not validated

  • Sensor sensitivity / true-negative opportunity.
  • Physical spread, calibrated anomaly.
  • AI downscaling or pre-VIIRS reconstruction.

Next: full fire masks, valid-pixel/cloud QA, geolocation, authentic environment and independent years/geographies.
